name: aho-voice-conversationrelay
description: AHO voice channel — Cloudflare Worker that terminates the Twilio ConversationRelay WebSocket. Receives transcribed user turns, bridges to the shared Claude orchestrator (src/lib/ai/converse.ts via the Pages app), emits TTS-bound text events back to Twilio. See ../../docs/AI_AGENT_PLAN.md §4d.
